title: What the Door Bundle Credit Is Figured On
content:
# What the Door Bundle Credit Is Figured On

Window Replacement Contracts — the amount the door bundle credit is figured on depends on which contract began the project, read from the signing dates of the window contract and the paired Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract.

**Rule.** When the door contract was signed before this window contract, the door was the first purchase and the credit is figured on the window product only, the series base price per opening times the openings the completed final measure confirmed (the largest count should more than one completed final measure be recorded, and the contract's openings while it is not yet measured), with no credit on options; when both were signed on the same day, the two were bought as one project and the credit is figured on the signed contract price plus the customer change-order lines on the contract; when the window contract was signed before the door contract, the credit is figured on the signed contract price.

Customer change-order lines are the option and added-opening lines; an oversize surcharge line is not one. The rate of the credit multiplies this amount, and the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Which contract was signed first | Amount the credit is figured on |
|---|---|
| The door contract | Series base price per opening times the openings confirmed at the completed final measure (the largest count if more than one is recorded; contract openings if not yet measured); options excluded |
| Both on the same day | Signed contract price plus the customer change-order lines |
| The window contract | Signed contract price |

## Hypothetical cases (signed price $20,000; base price a hypothetical $1,000 per opening; 12 openings confirmed; change-order lines $1,500)

- Door signed first: figured on $12,000.
- Same day: figured on $21,500.
- Window signed first: figured on $20,000.
